query: WITH [["Conditional Handover (CHO, Rel-16)", "Conditional PSCell Addition/Change (CPAC, Rel-18)"], ["Conditional Handover (CHO, Rel-16)", "Conditional PSCell Change (CPC, Rel-16)"], ["Conditional Handover (CHO, Rel-16)", "LTM (L1/L2 Triggered Mobility, Rel-18)"], ["Conditional PSCell Addition/Change (CPAC, Rel-18)", "Conditional PSCell Change (CPC, Rel-16)"], ["Conditional PSCell Addition/Change (CPAC, Rel-18)", "LTM (L1/L2 Triggered Mobility, Rel-18)"], ["Conditional PSCell Change (CPC, Rel-16)", "LTM (L1/L2 Triggered Mobility, Rel-18)"]] AS expected OPTIONAL MATCH (a:Feature)-[:disjointWith]-(b:Feature) WITH expected,collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a IS NULL THEN null WHEN a.name <= b.name THEN [a.name,b.name] ELSE [b.name,a.name] END) AS actual RETURN size(actual)=size(expected) AND all(pair IN actual WHERE all(member IN pair WHERE member IS NOT NULL)) AND all(pair IN expected WHERE pair IN actual) AS matches
